name: sidecar-bf42pp-nfr
description: sidecar-levelchange with BF42++ server settings in its welcome lines (features/udp-sidecar/wire.md section 30): line 0 carries %UI&nfr~ (no faster restart), line 1 a 3D mine marker setting. A bf42++ client, and the sidecar, parse them; at the level change the sidecar's restart pinger then waits the retail 16 s before its first probe and keeps bf42++'s 2 s interval.
human: No game client. Run the sidecar (`node tools/bf1942-models/sidecar/sidecar.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568 --name rejoinA --team 2`) and a filler (`node tools/bf1942-models/sidecar/join.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568 --name filler --stay 0`). Expect `bf42++ server settings: UI` then `UI, 3DM (no faster restart)` on the join, and at the level change `probing the server after 16 s, then every 2 s`. Control: sidecar-levelchange.json (no welcome lines) gives `after 1 s, then every 2 s`; `--retail` gives `after 16 s, then every 3 s`.
